head_commit.message:
Stage 3 pipeline (tia), nightly coverage maps, shardkit units-file, tia force-full and coverage converters

- ci-optimized.yml: stage 3, select job runs scripts/ci_select.py (tia) and gates every job
- nightly-full.yml: per-test coverage maps for all three apps, committed to experiments/coverage
- run shardkit as a module in workflows (fixes relative import error in ci-parallel)
- manual dispatches publish images like pushes, so dispatched baseline runs are equivalent

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
